B/R identical except guidance source (R: no rows, no templates).

learning_budget_estimate.kl_geometry: uniform(9 slots)->0.8: 1.11 nats, Fisher-Rao 1.53; >= 6 capped updates (straight-line bound)
learning_budget_estimate.ppo: always-on solo2 effect at D3200_p60 (u0): ~8 paired episodes at episode level; per-decision credit is far more diluted -> EV-BC carries WHEN, PPO/G4 refine; with the inherited row-SUM PPO KL guard (~150 CAV rows/step) PPO admitted only ~3e-4 nats/CAV/update
learning_budget_estimate.g4: 8-12 starts/arm/run (registered caps) is too sparse to teach group moves alone; >= ~50 starts/arm would be needed
learning_budget_estimate.generalisation: per-moment WHEN unlearnable (LEARNABILITY); EV targets depend only on cell regime (observable traffic level) + own lane -> report_valsplit_auc each update is the check
